    • withExpirationDateTime

      public ServiceTokenOperator.ServiceTokenBuilder withExpirationDateTime(LocalDateTime expirationDateTime)
      Sets the expiration date and time of the service token.

      UTC contract: the LocalDateTime input is UTC wall clock (matching every timestamp the SDK returns, including ServiceToken.getExpirationDateTime()); it is sent verbatim with a 'Z' designator. Use LocalDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC) as the base for relative expirations.

      Parameters:
      expirationDateTime - the expiration as UTC wall clock, sent as expirationDateTime
      Returns:
      this builder
